title: Pulled Off the File
setup: The queen on b6 guards the rook on d8 along a diagonal and the knight on b4 down the b-file.
hint: Which black piece is holding two things at once, and what can you offer it that must be taken?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxd8+}} forces {{Qxd8}}, the only legal reply, and the queen abandons b4. {{Bxb4}} wins a piece. An overworked defender only has to be asked one question too many. The check is not the point; the square the queen has to leave is.
